propositions: The retired LLM re-review trigger word 'recheck-review' collides with external CI's substring-based 'recheck' ChatOps matcher, causing spurious Verified -1 cancellations on in-flight CI runs.
The bot's own reply texts embed the retired trigger word verbatim in Gerrit comments, causing the bot's replies themselves to re-dispatch spurious CI verification workflows.
Hard cutover from 'recheck-review' to 'rerun-llm-review' eliminates the collision substring while the retired word now triggers a single refusal reply instead of any review action.
All bot-posted reply texts (accepted message, findings refusal, retired-word refusal) must be scrubbed of any ini-mapped comment-added trigger keys to prevent self-re-dispatch.
The retired-word refusal branch is placed after project guard and change re-anchoring to ensure post_comment never replies on out-of-project changes or unresolvable change keys.
